name: Wades Network Background
author: wadebush

sections.description:
Wades Network Background creates a polished network of drifting dots and fading connecting lines using the browser canvas. It works automatically with common Elementor sliders and carousels, Slider Revolution and Master Slider.

You can apply the effect to any Elementor section or container by adding the CSS class wades-network-effect under Advanced → CSS Classes.

Features

  • Animated dots with distance-based connecting lines
  • Gentle pointer interaction
  • Automatic Elementor slider and carousel detection
  • Slider Revolution and Master Slider support
  • Custom Elementor CSS class support
  • Adjustable colours, density, speed, line distance and opacity
  • Intersection Observer pauses animation when off screen
  • Resize Observer keeps the canvas responsive
  • Respects reduced-motion preferences
  • No external JavaScript libraries or tracking
  • Does not obstruct links, buttons or slider navigation

The free edition is complete and has no trial period or usage limits. An optional separately distributed Pro add-on provides additional presets and controls.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins → Add New, or install it from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate Wades Network Background.
  3. Common slider widgets are detected automatically.
  4. For a specific Elementor container, add wades-network-effect under Advanced → CSS Classes.
  5. Adjust global controls under Settings → Network Background.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

No. Elementor selectors are included for convenience, but the custom CSS class works with any WordPress theme or builder.

Will it block buttons or slider controls?

No. The canvas uses pointer-events: none and navigation controls are kept above the animation layer.

Does it run when off screen?

No. Animation pauses when the target leaves the viewport.

Can I use it on only one section?

Yes. Add wades-network-effect only to the section or container where you want the effect.

Is there a Pro edition?

Yes. The separately distributed Pro add-on adds presets, per-section configuration, advanced pointer modes, click bursts and performance controls. The free plugin remains fully functional without Pro.
